items.issue: Rapid-kiss games and very high-volume street approaches can involve unwanted contact, harassment and using strangers as practice targets.
items.disposition: Do not convert into action advice; explicit consent, lawful conduct and immediate stopping are required.

items.issue: Friends, classmates and partners are assigned betrayal, ridicule or other motives through one-sided recollection.
items.disposition: Keep as Mikey's recollection; do not identify people or state allegations as fact.

items.issue: Acne treatment and later improvement are a personal medical narrative without diagnosis, regimen verification or causal control.
items.disposition: Do not recommend a treatment; direct users to qualified clinicians.

items.issue: Bullying, shame, gaming, avoidance and later behavior are woven into a single causal story.
items.disposition: Do not diagnose or assume the same pathway for users.

items.issue: Frequent sex, dating success and coaching transformation are unverified self-report in a promotional biography.
items.disposition: Do not use as efficacy evidence or a promised outcome.

items.issue: Family, classmates, partners, social posts and approach participants appear in photos or clips with uncertain reuse consent.
items.disposition: Do not expose identities; require privacy review before any reuse.

items.issue: The narrative describes fake luxury/status photos and scripted persona tactics.
items.disposition: Retain only the critique of mismatch; never recommend deceptive representation.
